summary: Lakshmi is the same employee behind an expanded payroll name, an initialled Jira name and reversed GitHub display order. She teaches tenant-access controls and independently maintains the scanner export, but paired Java work and network verification can be mistaken for service or Kubernetes ownership.

skills.why: Other service maintainers adopted her negative-test method and exception controls.
Owns a scheduled reporting module and resolves pagination, expiry and runtime failures.
Independently builds and executes negative API checks which catch tenant leakage.
Independently diagnoses and remediates IAM access failures; certification is supporting context only.
Uses platform correction for configuration mechanics and validates the resulting access behaviour.
Current host-access remediation plus sustained operations experience support independent service administration.
Her security reviews catch deployable defects; evidence does not establish general reviewer coaching.
Support can execute the revised procedure with the expected diagnostics.
Privately she can modify a bounded assertion or endpoint with help; the co-author owns lifecycle and middleware design.
Private assessor observed her run two containment handovers in 2026. Restricted incident records were excluded, so the visible export is inadequate for confident outreach.
She ran an outbound probe after platform remediation, with no cluster operation or retained Kubernetes knowledge.

decoys.why: Network-policy verification was a security check performed after someone else repaired the cluster.

traps.plant: Payroll expands Lakshmi’s name; Jira uses an initial and GitHub reverses the order. Dated alias records share KC-10919.
traps.catalog_note: No exact name-order entry exists in F01-F36. F22 concerns a changed name, which did not occur here.

traps.plant: The scanner egress issue has a late transfer to Lakshmi after the platform engineer repairs the network policy.
Two Java PRs explicitly split security assertions from middleware and fixture work performed by a co-author.

answer_behavior.notes: Checks the wording carefully; will clarify scope of Java work and decline cluster ownership. Does not recognise an identity split as two people.
